method: Source-of-record check at authoring time, then a separate second pass re-reading every numeric and quoted claim against the page it came from. Author and checker are the same pass, which is not the independent arrangement the older batches used.

findings.claim: Critical mineral markets have become more concentrated, with the top three refining nations' average market share rising to 86% in 2024 from around 82% in 2020
Investment in critical minerals grew by just 5% in 2024, down from 14% in 2023
Lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese and graphite for batteries; rare earths for permanent magnets in wind turbines and EV motors; aluminium and copper for networks
Recycling could reduce the growth in new mining supply by 25 to 40 per cent by mid-century
The Mineral Commodity Summaries is published annually, is the earliest government publication of nonfuel mineral data, and covers over 90 minerals with five-year statistics
Refining concentrates because it is chemically demanding, capital-intensive, regulated and subject to economies of scale
findings.note: Offered as a structural explanation for the concentration the IEA reports; no figures attached.

findings.claim: Graphite-anode lithium-ion batteries are limited to 299 Wh/kg, which cannot meet a 500 km EV range demand
Lithium metal has a theoretical capacity of 3862 mAh/g and the lowest redox potential of -3.04 V vs SHE
Lithium metal batteries reach at least 440 Wh/kg, with high-voltage cathodes above 550 Wh/kg and 1400 Wh/L, and a champion Li//LNP cell at 618 Wh/kg and 1541 Wh/L
The four failure modes are dendrite, dead lithium, corrosion and volume expansion, leading to capacity loss and even explosion
Graphite's specific capacity is roughly 372 mAh/g, about a tenth of lithium metal's
findings.note: The 372 figure appeared in a search summary rather than in the page we read; the article states it as 'roughly' and the tenfold ratio is the sourced claim.

findings.claim: Coin-cell results do not transfer to pouch cells, and stack pressure and temperature conditions matter
findings.note: Written as reading guidance rather than as a finding.

findings.claim: The life-cycle stages are one-time upstream, ongoing combustion, ongoing non-combustion, one-time downstream and total, in g CO2e/kWh
The technologies covered include biopower, coal, CSP, geothermal, hydrogen storage, hydropower, lithium-ion storage, natural gas, nuclear, ocean, oil, photovoltaic, pumped storage and wind
The dataset provides quartile estimates, compiled by the LCA Harmonization study and subsequent updates
Median life-cycle emissions of 13 g CO2-eq/kWh for nuclear, 450 for NGCC and 670 for NGCT
findings.note: These figures came from search summaries. nrel.gov and docs.nrel.gov did not resolve from this environment, and the OSTI records we could read give structure rather than values. No per-technology medians are published in the article.

findings.claim: The purpose of harmonisation is to reduce spread caused by methodological inconsistency
A twenty-year 35% capacity factor assumption against a thirty-year 45% one differs by nearly a factor of two in amortised construction emissions
findings.note: Our worked example, not a figure from a study.

findings.claim: Scaling recycling could reduce the growth in new mining supply for critical minerals by 25 to 40 per cent by mid-century
Recovered material still requires refining, where supply concentration sits
A growing installed stock cannot be supplied from its own retirements because retirements reflect deployment one product lifetime ago
findings.note: Our argument for why the IEA figure is about growth rather than total supply; no rates are quoted.

findings.claim: Collection, separation and commodity-price economics are the three obstacles
Rare earths are indispensable to the permanent magnets used in wind turbines and EV motors
The top three refining nations' share rose to 86% in 2024 from around 82% in 2020
Permanent magnet performance requires both a large magnetic moment and magnetocrystalline anisotropy from spin-orbit coupling, which rare earths supply through their partially filled inner shells
findings.sourceChecked: standard solid-state physics; not quoted from a source read in this pass
findings.note: The physical explanation is standard and is stated without figures; the IEA source establishes the dependency, not the mechanism.

findings.claim: Grain-boundary diffusion reduces the quantity of the scarcest elements needed for a given thermal stability
findings.note: Named as a route without a quantity.

findings.claim: The material-to-technology mapping for batteries, magnets and networks
Recycling could reduce the growth in new mining supply by 25 to 40 per cent by mid-century
Complementarity — a site's value is what it adds to the existing set — is the organising idea of systematic conservation planning
findings.note: Carried from an existing verified article and applied to a new case; the application is ours.

findings.claim: Access roads, processing, tailings and induced settlement commonly exceed the pit in area and consequence
findings.note: Stated as a common pattern without a figure.
